declarations.description: One row in a `ui-combobox`. Place it in the combobox's `options` slot. The default slot is the row content, stacked in a column. `value` is the string the combobox stores when this row is chosen. `label` is what the field shows. Neither is the row's text. `ui-combobox` sets `active` on the highlighted row and `selected` when `value` matches the combobox value. No events. No public methods.
